fire:
What kind of work do you do in your studio?
I am a ceramic artist and mostly make bowls and vases.

Q: How did you first get into chess?
A: My father taught me when I was six.

Can you give an example of that approach?
Dr. Lee: One method we use is long-term field sampling.

Is it true that you once lived on a boat?
Yes, that was about ten years ago now.

Interviewer: What games have you played?
What I've played: chess, Go and a lot of poker.

How did that change your research?
PROF. KIM: Sure, it changed everything about our sampling.

What do you do for a living?
I am a carpenter and I build custom furniture.

What was your first job?
Well, I started out washing dishes in a diner.
